deterministic file operations (no UI drift),

reproducible commits/pushes,

real diff visibility,

and an execution surface MetaBlooms can target (scripts).

What matters is how we do it: CLI is Class A for authority work only if we enforce the same invariants (atomic writes, hashes, append-only ledgers, fail-closed gates).
